newsHighlights.title: Shanghai import expo sets several records
newsHighlights.summary: Multiple records and vibrant trading at the 9th China International Import Expo mirror China's continued efforts to advance innovation and stabilize global trade.
newsHighlights.translation: 第九届中国国际进口博览会上创下的多项纪录和活跃的交易，反映出中国持续推进创新、稳定全球贸易的努力。

newsHighlights.title: Figures that define this year's CIIE
newsHighlights.summary: The ninth edition of the CIIE, the world's first import-themed national-level exhibition, concluded on Nov 10 with its scale reaching a new high.
newsHighlights.translation: 全球首个以进口为主题的国家级展会——第九届进博会于11月10日闭幕，办展规模创下新高。

newsHighlights.title: Momentum in trade bolsters growth outlook
newsHighlights.summary: China's sustained trade momentum has strengthened expectations for steady economic growth in the coming months.
newsHighlights.translation: 中国持续的贸易增长势头增强了未来几个月经济稳步增长的预期。

newsHighlights.title: 'Skillcations' enrich holiday experiences
newsHighlights.summary: A growing number of travelers are spending holidays learning crafts such as ceramics, adding vocational skills to leisure trips.
newsHighlights.translation: 越来越多的游客在假期学习陶瓷等手工艺，为休闲旅行增添职业技能体验。

newsHighlights.title: Xi calls on APEC members to work together amid challenges
newsHighlights.summary: China urged APEC members to enhance cooperation and uphold open regionalism as global economic challenges mount.
newsHighlights.translation: 面对日益增多的全球经济挑战，中国呼吁亚太经合组织成员加强合作、坚持开放的区域主义。

quote.quote: The purpose of business is to create a customer.
quote.author: Peter Drucker
quote.translation: 企业的目的在于创造顾客。
quote.explanation: 管理学大师德鲁克认为，企业存在的意义不是单纯追求利润，而是发现并满足顾客的需求。正如进博会所展示的：把全球优质商品带入中国市场，本质上就是在不断创造和服务新的消费者。

pattern.pattern: sth. + 过去分词短语（作后置定语）+ mirror/reflect + sth.'s efforts to do sth.
pattern.example: Multiple records and trading vibrancy witnessed at the just-concluded 9th China International Import Expo mirror China's continued efforts to advance innovation and stabilize global trade.
pattern.translation: 第九届中国国际进口博览会上创下的多项纪录和活跃的交易，反映出中国持续推进创新、稳定全球贸易的努力。
pattern.usage: 用于新闻写作中，把客观现象与深层意义相连接。结构为：名词 + 过去分词短语（补充说明背景）+ 谓语动词（mirror / reflect / highlight）+ 主体的努力或趋势。写作时注意过去分词短语要紧跟被修饰的名词，且不带自己的主语。

grammar.title: 过去分词短语作后置定语
grammar.explanation: 在新闻英语中，常用「名词 + 过去分词短语」替代定语从句，使句子更紧凑。过去分词表示被动或已完成的动作，相当于 which was witnessed / which was concluded。判断方法：若名词是动作的承受者，用过去分词；若是执行者，用现在分词。
examples: Multiple records and trading vibrancy witnessed at the just-concluded 9th China International Import Expo mirror China's continued efforts to advance innovation and stabilize global trade.
The China International Import Expo, the world's first import-themed national-level exhibition, concluded its ninth edition on Nov 10.

pronunciation.tips: 重音在第二个音节 /ˈpæs/，首音节和末音节都是弱读的 /ə/。注意 /æ/ 要张大嘴、舌尖抵下齿，类似“哎”的口型。整词节奏为“轻—重—轻—轻”，切勿读成三个等重音节。
examples: New rockets will significantly lift the nation's launch capacity.
The expo venue has the capacity to host thousands of exhibitors.

reading.title: CIIE 2026: Records, Openness and a Brighter Trade Outlook
reading.content:
The ninth China International Import Expo concluded in Shanghai on Nov 10, closing a week of energetic trading and record-breaking deals. As the world's first import-themed national-level exhibition, the CIIE has grown steadily since its launch, and this year's edition reached a new high in scale.

Multiple records witnessed at the expo mirror China's continued efforts to advance innovation, open its market wider and stabilize global trade. Exhibitors from around the world brought thousands of new products to Chinese buyers, while agreements signed on site signaled strong confidence in the market.

Analysts say the momentum in trade bolsters the growth outlook for both China and its partners. At the same time, APEC members have been urged to work together amid shared challenges, keeping regional cooperation open and inclusive.

Beyond commerce, new trends are shaping demand as well: more travelers now book "skillcations" to learn crafts such as ceramics, showing that consumption in China is becoming richer and more diverse.
reading.translation:
第九届中国国际进口博览会于11月10日在上海闭幕，为期一周的活跃交易和破纪录的签约圆满收官。作为全球首个以进口为主题的国家级展会，进博会自创办以来稳步成长，本届办展规模再创新高。

博览会上见证的多项纪录，反映出中国持续推进创新、扩大市场开放、稳定全球贸易的努力。来自世界各地的展商为中国买家带来了数千种新产品，现场签署的协议彰显了他们对中国市场的强烈信心。

分析人士表示，贸易增长的势头提振了中国及其伙伴的增长前景。与此同时，各方呼吁亚太经合组织成员在共同挑战面前携手合作，坚持开放包容的区域合作。

在商业之外，新趋势也在塑造需求：越来越多的游客预订“技能假期”，学习陶瓷等手工艺，这表明中国的消费正变得更加丰富和多元。
reading.sourceNote: 本文基于 ChinaDaily 今日新闻「Shanghai import expo sets several records」「Figures that define this year's CIIE」「Momentum in trade bolsters growth outlook」「Xi calls on APEC members to work together amid challenges」及「'Skillcations' enrich holiday experiences」改写，用于英语学习目的。
